Yes, the court will likely enforce the bar, which is option C. I'm changing my earlier answer to A because I overlooked that the clause bars assignment of the contract "or any of its terms." That wording reaches the right to receive the $30,000, so the usual rule that a general clause bars only delegation doesn't apply. Option D's "favored restriction" rule isn't a real doctrine, and C is the closer fit even though "in all respects" overstates the rule. I'm also weighing the team note, and the UCC § 2-210 analysis behind A still points the other way.

CONFIDENCE: 58
